# AOSP source excerpts

`inputs/public-slices/*.json` contains line-bounded excerpts from the Android Open Source Project `platform/frameworks/base` repository at tag `android-14.0.0_r1`. The repository, path, line range, and original source URL are recorded in each JSON record. These excerpts retain their upstream Apache License 2.0 terms and are not relicensed by this artifact's MIT license.

The excerpts are used only as bounded, static, defensive-analysis inputs. They are not complete methods or a complete Android framework checkout. The checker validates their exact declared permission-call anchor and the accompanying BFIL projection; it does not claim a complete Java frontend or whole-method semantic coverage.
